classes.PILOT_CONTINUE_TO_CLOSEOUT: Both prospective boundaries were applied; collection ended at the first normal completion boundary; control sample and accounting are complete; no STOP/HOLD rule fired. This means only bounded internal review operation was acceptable.
classes.PILOT_HOLD_REVIEWER_COMPREHENSION: A frozen repeated reviewer-comprehension trigger fired, or unresolved contract-critical comprehension evidence prevents acceptable closeout.
classes.PILOT_HOLD_OPERATIONAL_BURDEN: Complete separated workload and maintenance evidence shows burden requiring governance review; no numeric burden threshold is manufactured by this pilot.
classes.PILOT_HOLD_SOURCE_RELIABILITY: Separated source/retrieval evidence prevents interpretable or acceptable operation without being a reviewer error.
classes.PILOT_STOP_SAFETY_BOUNDARY: Any zero-tolerance immediate stop condition fired.
classes.PILOT_INVALID_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Structural invalidity, material protocol corruption, incomplete required control review, or insufficient evidence makes validity indeterminable.

normal_closeout_eligibility: the prospective observation window reached its first normal completion boundary
every prospectively selected control-sample item completed independent review and adjudication
all required metrics are calculable or explicitly NOT_MEASURABLE
all guard and acknowledgement obligations are accounted for
the append-only maintenance ledger is complete with measurement status
both exact historical-transparency statements and retained R-I/R-J findings are included
success_does_not_authorize: pilot execution beyond the closed window
historical_transparency: Phase 5-4 did not pass its original two-human qualification gate.
Phase 5-5 proceeded under explicit owner governance override.
R-J Y507 genuine individual comprehension error
